description: Project the next 12 months of driving and list which maintenance services fall due in each month, from the odometer and monthly distance. Use when planning maintenance over the coming year. Do NOT use for what is due right now (use due_services) or prices (use service_cost_estimate).

km_per_month.description: Average distance driven per month in km (always km, 100-10000), e.g. 1200

months_since_last_oil.description: Months since the last oil change; time baseline for every service, default 0

odometer.description: Current odometer reading, non-negative, in the unit given by unit, e.g. 48000

unit.description: Unit of the odometer value: 'km' (default) or 'mi'

name: service_timeline

months.description: Twelve monthly entries, month 1 = next month

projected_km.description: Projected odometer in km at that month

title: Service timeline
